title: Alex Balashov
html:
Alex Balashov is the founder of Evariste Systems, an Atlanta-based software company, home of CSRP (www.csrpswitch.com), a Kamailio-based Class 4 routing and SIP trunking delivery solution for ITSPs and CLECs. He specialises in VoIP service delivery platform engineering, integration, and deployment for enterprises and service providers. He is one of the most active community members, answering requests and providing solutions, advocating Kamailio (OpenSER) and speaking about it at various on-site and online events.

Alex studied at University of Georgia, USA, working since then in IP communication and Telecomunication fields.

Contact: www.evaristesys.com
